results.title: Sage Research Methods - Talk and Interaction in Social Research Methods
results.content: 'This book admirably fulfils its stated objective of describing social research methods in action and exploring, from a range of perspectives, the linguistic shaping of social context. ' Talk and Interaction in Social Research Methodologies is a much-needed methods text. Focusing on research methods in action, the volume offers a new way of viewing the realities of social research. This is the first book of its kind to offer such a powerful and insightful depiction of the role of talk-in-interaction in relation to social research methods. This book is a must read for social researchers of all disciplines who are interested in social interaction. It demonstrates the importance of talk in a variety of social research methodologies. The book focuses systematically on how sociological methods are essentially conducted through forms of spoken interaction, and how these interactions shape the results that emerge in research.
